kits.label: 3D platformer
kits.pitch: Run, jump and stomp across floating islands, collect every star, reach the goal.

kits.label: Exploration quest
kits.pitch: Talk to a guide, roam a big landscape, bring back what was lost.

kits.label: Arena survival
kits.pitch: Top-down: move, dash and hold out through waves of cartoon foes.

kits.label: Kart time trial
kits.pitch: Three laps against the clock and a ghost. Drift, boost, take the medal.

kits.label: Walking mystery
kits.pitch: No foes and no clock: question people, find clues, name who did it.
